name: Hammertoe / Claw Toe Deformity
definition: Flexion deformity of one or more lesser toes caused by imbalance of intrinsic/extrinsic tendons and joints, ranging from flexible to rigid.

investigations.principle: Weight-bearing radiographs are used for structural/surgical assessment.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, vascular, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Rigid painful deformity may require tendon/bony correction.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Pada-anguli vikriti may be documented descriptively.

patientEducation.summary: Flexion deformity of one or more lesser toes caused by imbalance of intrinsic/extrinsic tendons and joints, ranging from flexible to rigid.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe vascular symptoms, infection/systemic illness, major trauma, sphincter change or other listed red flags.
